title: Premium Academy refinements verified across languages and themes
summary: Responsive dashboard, themed practice screens, empty-state recovery and completion milestones passed the expanded browser matrix and full learning journey.

changes.detail: Prioritize resume immediately alongside/below the hero, adapt desktop/tablet composition and localize weekday labels. Notification shortcut opens notification preferences.
Reusable empty-state actions, collection recovery links, missing-path recovery and a real completion milestone for all published path lessons.
Suppress misleading empty bookmarks when saved code exists, translate French clear-search label and react to reduced-motion setting changes.
Replace independent curriculum, speaking and coding challenge palettes with shared semantic theme tokens; retain readable dark code surfaces.

validation.name: TypeScript, full lint and tests
validation.detail: Typecheck and full ESLint passed; 304 tests passed, zero failed.

validation.name: Expanded browser matrix
validation.detail: 151 checks: 144 route visits (24 routes x English/French/Arabic x light/dark), six five-tab navigation checks, and recovery/completion interactions. Widths 320/390, plus home at 768/1280. Zero browser errors. Corrected html-css test fixture before this completed run.

validation.name: Visual review
validation.detail: Reviewed actual English desktop light/dark, Arabic 320px light and desktop dark, empty notes, speaking and completed-path renders. Screenshots are saved test snapshots, not deployed or historical app builds.

validation.name: Learning journey
validation.detail: Fresh export passed onboarding, contextual teacher/formula UI, lesson quiz/readiness, real code success/error and grading, flashcard review and state restoration after reopening. Authentication and teacher transport are fixtures.

validation.name: Web and Android builds
validation.detail: Fresh web export and Android Hermes export succeeded. Android export does not establish on-device behavior.

validation.name: Current development preview
validation.detail: Started the existing development workflow on http://localhost:8081. Checked real sign-in UI and displayed the new Change History report in an isolated fixture-authenticated browser context. Startup regenerated the existing offline car runtime.

validation.name: Limits
validation.detail: No physical Android/iOS keyboard, screen-reader, native font-scaling, WebView formula or frame-rate testing. No live paid teacher call. No deployment.
